checks.title: Confirm case goal and owners
checks.instructions: Name the merchant, operations owner, refund approval owner, customer contact owner, service goal, and applicable escalation policy.

checks.title: Bind the exact store and order
checks.instructions: Record stable store, order, customer reference, affected line-item IDs, exception window and timezone. Prove a fulfillment, payment, and support record belongs to the same store/order before joining it.

checks.title: Confirm return, refund, and contact policy
checks.instructions: Record the applicable policy version and dates, affected line fulfillment status, customer request versus actual Shopify Return, currency, captured and already-refunded amounts, taxes, shipping, discounts, gift cards, disputes, partial items, approval thresholds, and prior-contact rules. Only a fulfilled item can take the Shopify Return route; leave an unsupported refund amount unknown.

checks.title: Bind ready Shopify Crews
checks.instructions: Record existing or reviewed new Store Operations Coordinator and Returns & Refunds Coordinator Crew IDs, selected skills, and setup status. One Crew may fill both only with compatible access and separate validated outputs.

checks.title: Test actual source access
checks.instructions: Read one authorized Shopify order and transaction, the relevant fulfillment and return state, and prior support contact or bounded exports. Record exact IDs, freshness, missing records, and permitted write routes.

checks.title: Validate order and policy handoffs
checks.instructions: Validate store-order-exception/v1 before the Returns Crew reads it, then validate return-resolution-review/v1 for the same store, order, case, and currency. Reject wrong-store, wrong-order, duplicate-refund, and unsupported-issued fixtures.

checks.title: Review the Automation plan
checks.instructions: Show actual Crew IDs, source field scope, policy rule, artifact paths, validator steps, refund and message approval gates, run cost, and manual activation state to the merchant owner.

checks.title: Run one real case manually
checks.instructions: Use a real authorized order/return case or historical case with current source records. Record Crew run IDs, artifacts, validator results, owner review, and observed outcome or unknown state. Fictional fixtures do not complete setup.

checks.title: Track decisions and receipts
checks.instructions: Keep stable store, order, case, action, refund, and ticket IDs, owner, proposed versus approved action, exact customer draft, provider receipt, next check, and duplicate prevention state.

checks.title: Choose the run policy
checks.instructions: Record manual-only or an authenticated store/support event with concurrency, retries, persistent delivery-ID deduplication, stable case/action keys, budget, notifications, and approval rules. Test a real event before enabling it. A Shopify webhook signals a source re-read; it does not prove a refund or delivery. Setup completion does not refund, send, or close a case.
